approvals_target_chk.name: approvals_target_chk
approvals_target_chk.value: ("approvals"."id_purchase_requests" is not null)::int + ("approvals"."id_payments" is not null)::int = 1

stock_movements_type_chk.name: stock_movements_type_chk
stock_movements_type_chk.value:
"stock_movements"."qty_delta" <> 0 and (
        ("stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('opening_balance','receipt') and "stock_movements"."qty_delta" > 0) or
        ("stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('usage','damaged','expired') and "stock_movements"."qty_delta" < 0) or
        "stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('adjustment','opname_adjustment'))
